candidates.lock_freeze_note: Initial lock ignored MESLEK_UNVAN and TUZEL_KISI in addition to O; evaluation owner was notified and controls conservative INTERNAL remapping and subsequent lock hash. Research lane did not mutate active lock.
evidence: Author reports 8,014-document mixture of Turkish web PDFs, anonymized high-court decisions, born-labeled synthetic documents and OCR-degraded synthetic documents; 7,763 retained for training.
Author's 300-document test is not released; annotations are model-panel and rules based; only 17 of 25 entity labels covered.
Released checkpoint overlap micro-F2=0.8101 is not strict full-span F1; run.json strict test_f1=0.681491 is a different metric.

Author prescribes first WordPiece per whitespace word / aggregation_strategy first; pinned trainer masks continuation/special labels to -100, uses is_split_into_words=True, and evaluation removes masked labels. Existing worker raw-tokenizer argmax over all token logits is not guaranteed author-equivalent; paired unchanged-corpus comparison is required before asserting a defect or benefit.
Count once: both repositories expose byte-identical weight SHA, architecture and 43 BIO labels.
2,400 deterministic synthetic rows; no demonstrated real-world accuracy.
Inference from author's generator and trainer: ADDRESS is assigned only index%18==1, while validation requires index%10==8; ADDRESS indices are odd so none can enter validation.
Generator has five repeated street-number/district forms and lacks full neighborhood/city/apartment/floor/postcode coverage. This is generator analysis, not an audit of every raw row.
Local installed Transformers 5.13.0 resolves native AutoConfig and token-classification mapping; no remote code or new dependency required for root HF-format artifacts.
Reduced random native model completed offline CPU forward with finite shape [1,4,33], eager experts/attention. This does not verify actual pretrained load, RAM, speed or quality.
Root fast tokenizer is TokenizersBackend, not tiktoken; maximum model length 128000 is not an advised CPU evaluation window.
Author recommends constrained BIOES Viterbi decoding. Current independent token argmax aggregation does not reproduce that decoder.

Author's Turkish synthetic robustness slice: 956 examples, P=0.852, R=0.883, F1=0.867. Clue-before-PII Turkish slice: 1192 examples, P=0.824, R=0.715. Primarily English base; synthetic metrics are not current qualification.
Current Transformers loader defaults dtype=auto and native config is BF16. Disk size must not be equated with actual CPU RAM; full checkpoint RAM/speed remain unmeasured.
Current installer has both architecture whitelist and 2GiB per-file cap blockers for this 2798989498-byte native checkpoint.

Pinned decoder permits O/B/S at start, O/E/S at end; O/E/S -> O or B/S, B/I -> same-category I/E; impossible transitions -1e9 and all six shipped transition biases zero. Logprob-emission max-plus dynamic programming with backtracking; no learned CRF weights required.
Actual config has 35 BIO labels including PERSON, STREET_ADDRESS, GPE and ZIP_CODE. No full ADDRESS label despite README prose.
Card claims multilingual 1800+ languages but supplies no Turkish PII training corpus or language-specific evaluation artifact.

Exact current runtime instantiated config on meta device; all 138 local state_dict names/shapes match immutable remote safetensors header read via HTTP206 64KiB range; zero mismatches. This is load-structure proof, not inference.
Author maps street, building number, city, state, postcode, country, county, apartment and suite into ADDRESS. Whole address coverage is intended but isolated cities/countries may cause false alarms.

Model card and author GitHub license declare MIT, but training source ai4privacy/pii-masking-200k has conditional organizational/corporate licensing and derivative restrictions at reviewed revision. Effect on trained weights needs provenance review; no Legal approval claimed.
Synthetic AI4Privacy plus Faker training and self-reported metrics do not establish current clean-negative or exact-span gates.

Current card license CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0, six supported languages exclude Turkish; component address labels.
MIT standard English RoBERTa experiment, but actual synthetic sample marks London LOCATION outside street ADDRESS; no demonstrated full postal span semantics or quantitative qualification.
MIT Turkish address-component parser; no PERSON and no unified full ADDRESS span; current per-model installer requires both PERSON and ADDRESS.
Public repository contains card/config/inference documentation but no model weights or tokenizer artifacts.

Same component-label/no verified Turkish evaluation limitation as BiomedBERTFull; standard 435823712-byte weights do not establish full ADDRESS quality.
